decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for a takeaway (A5 use), shall not take place anywhere on the site except within the building.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 10am to 12 midnight on Monday to Friday 10am to 11pm on Saturday, Sunday and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 6 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times:10:00am to 10:00pm on any day.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a takeaway (A5 use) shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the restaurant and the residential flats above and to the rear of the shop, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted for a takeaway (A5 use) shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before the use hereby permitted for a takeaway (A5 use) is commenced.

Condition : 9 - Details of a kitchen extract system shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing, and shall be implemented in accordance with approved details, before the use hereby approved as a takeaway (A5) is commenced.The system shall be designed so that the maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.h) Fan units and filters should be located inside the building envelope with silencers provided to on or both side so of the fan as necessary.
description: Change of use from hairdressers (A1) to commercial food establishment (A5) and alteration of shopfront (Amended description)
